metadata.name: meridian
metadata.description: Meridian: binary stock-outcome contracts on Solana

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Instruction 1 (ARCHITECTURE.md §6): creates Config, once, signed by the program's upgrade key (AR.03).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Signs and pays the deposit.

accounts.name: program
docs: The upgrade-key gate (AR.03): this program's own ProgramData, whose upgrade key signed.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade key may initialize the config

errors.name: MainnetUsdcOnDevnet
errors.msg: The devnet build refuses mainnet USDC

errors.name: MissingKey
errors.msg: A key in the config is missing

errors.name: InvalidReceivers
errors.msg: Accepted price programs: one or two, distinct, none missing

errors.name: InvalidTickers
errors.msg: Tickers: one to eight, distinct, 1 to 8 capital letters, a feed ID and a strike step each

errors.name: InvalidLadder
errors.msg: The strike ladder must be 1 to 50 percent, in rising order

errors.name: InvalidThresholds
errors.msg: A threshold is out of range

fields.name: admin
docs: Runs the admin instructions (D24). A key file on the laptop on devnet (D92).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: The proposed next admin, until they accept (two-step rotation, D109).

fields.name: operator
docs: The backend's key: creates markets and settles, but can't pause or override (A5).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The dollar token. Circle's devnet USDC on devnet (D32).

fields.name: pyth_receivers
docs: Programs whose price accounts are accepted: Pyth's legacy and upgraded receivers (D80).

fields.name: tickers
docs: The stocks, each pinned to its regular-session feed (D55, D28).

fields.name: ladder_bps
docs: Strike offsets from the previous close, in basis points: ±3, 6 and 9% (D6, D49).

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops Mint pairs and Place order only (D68).

fields.name: fill_limit
docs: The most fills one order may take. Set from M1's order-book spike; 0 until then (D21).

types.name: ConfigInitialized
docs: Instruction 1's event (ARCHITECTURE.md §6).

types.name: Thresholds
docs: The times and limits the program enforces, with ARCHITECTURE.md §11's devnet values.

fields.name: orders_close_before_secs
docs: Orders close this long before the stored close: 5 s (D102).

fields.name: publish_window_secs
docs: A recorded price must be published within this of the close: 5 s (D103).

fields.name: max_band_bps
docs: The widest price band accepted: 25 basis points (D106).

fields.name: override_bound_bps
docs: An override within this of the reference waits the short wait: 0.5% (D104).

fields.name: override_wait_secs
docs: The short wait before an override is final: 1 hour (D63, D104).

fields.name: override_wait_long_secs
docs: The wait outside the bound, or with no reference: 24 hours (D104).

fields.name: operator_only_settle_secs
docs: Only the operator may settle for this long after the close: 24 hours (D58).

fields.name: admin_hold_backstop_secs
docs: An admin hold lapses after this: 24 hours (D68).

fields.name: band_hold_backstop_secs
docs: A band-on-the-strike hold lapses after this: 7 days (D68).

fields.name: no_price_hold_after_secs
docs: With no recorded price this long after the close, the market is held: 15 minutes (D83).

fields.name: symbol
docs: "META": 1 to 8 capital letters.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth's 32-byte feed ID for the stock's regular-session price (Equity.US.<ticker>/USD).

fields.name: strike_step_cents
docs: Strikes are multiples of this, in cents: $10 is 1000 (D49).

fields.name: enabled
docs: New markets only for enabled stocks.
